A large floor-to-ceiling window behind her reveals a bright, clear view of the Taipei skyline, with the Taipei 101 tower clearly visible in the distance. The desk has a small mirror, a potted plant, and some papers. (2) The scene cuts to a medium-full shot of the woman standing as two staff members adjust her white outfit. She is wearing a white crop top and matching trousers under her blazer. One staff member is in a grey hoodie and plaid pants, while another in black holds a styling tool. They are working in the same sunlit office space. (3) The perspective shifts to a large, open event hall with white ceilings and industrial lighting. Rows of black folding chairs are perfectly aligned, each carrying a pink and white gift bag. On the far wall, a large graphic banner reads 'MAYUKI CHOU 1st FAN MEETING (IN TAIPEI)'. People are seen walking in the background, preparing the venue. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a white welcome sign featuring a logo of a red chili pepper wearing sunglasses. The text 'MAYUKI CHOU 1st FAN MEETING' is printed below. The background shows blurred greenery and the event seating, indicating the entrance or a photo area.
